recommendations.explanation: The voice memo about the 0.6x gain reached no session, so the drafter could not tell which rig or recording it describes.

guide.title: Have a session open when you dictate
steps: Start a session on "Home" with "Start session" before you record memos with the hands-free shortcut.
The shortcut files each memo into your most recently started open session, so memos recorded while it is open arrive linked to it.
